reviewed_flags.title: High share of zero exit knowledge scores
reviewed_flags.observation: Seventy-two of 235 matched respondents score zero at exit; 28 batteries are wholly blank and 44 have at least one recorded answer, including possible explicit DK responses.
reviewed_flags.interpretation: The high zero-score share is unusual but does not establish false records. The blank-quiz people answered other exit questions, and source knowledge aliases reproduce original SPSS cells. A zero denotes no credited answers on a four-item battery. Battery length and response patterns must be considered when comparing polls.

publication_bridge.qualification: Publication means use 235 matched questionnaires, whereas historical group analyses use 233. One of 28 blank exits, p36, has no historical group assignment. Retain the three approved Q45 source-reconciliation credits.

reviewed_flags.footnote: Zeguo retains72 zero exit knowledge scores among235 matched respondents (30.6%), including28 wholly blank batteries. Published knowledge means include these cases. Sensitivity analyses distinguish exclusion of all-zero scores from exclusion of wholly blank batteries.
